label.deletedList.note: a condition's list that no longer exists

mailbox.other.note: mailbox providers other than Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and iCloud

note.failover: {provider} was down; Broadcasts failed over to {fallback}

error.down.note: why a transactional message's attempt failed, in the transactional log

error.unreadable.note: error: what went wrong, in English

error.allFailed.message: Every provider in the route failed: {error}
